conflict_flags.rationale: The BOD is a later document (August 2022 vs. February 2020 SAES) representing the completed design intent. The SAES is the scoping document written before design commenced. Scope clearly changed during design: the pop-up retail space was removed and Vendor #2 was enlarged from 3,000 SF to 3,500 SF. The 100% BOD reflects the final, built scope.
